primary_endpoint: Proportion achieving NASH resolution without worsening of fibrosis, fibrosis improvement by ≥1 stage without worsening of NASH, or both, at Week 48.
efficacy_outcome: At Week 48, Bayesian-model proportions were 0.38 with placebo and 0.45, 0.48, 0.50, and 0.51 with PF-06865571 at 25, 75, 150, and 300 mg BID, respectively. Statistical comparisons were not reported.
safety_signal: Serious adverse events occurred in 1/34 placebo participants and 1/35, 5/48, 1/42, and 4/31 participants receiving PF-06865571 at 25, 75, 150, and 300 mg BID; rates were 5/35 and 2/30 with combination arms. No deaths were reported.
